drafted_from: tools/see-what-my-business-took-in-this-month/tool-rows.json (tool:stripe-events-read_money_since, an http row) and the tests in test/business-screen.test.mjs that exercise it; not run against Stripe: the answer is read from the row's request template and the test's Stripe answer
start_here: Say to your AI: "List the money that moved on my Stripe account since October 1, 2026, newest first, at most 100 entries."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it asks your own Stripe connection for the balance transactions since a moment and answers them unchanged.
instructions: 1. Connect Stripe in Connections so the door holds your secret key; the key is sent only to api.stripe.com and never shown.
2. Say "List the money that moved on my Stripe account since October 1, 2026". The AI runs tool:stripe-events-read_money_since with since set to seconds since 1970 UTC (1790812800 for that moment).

3. Read the answer: data (Stripe's balance transactions, newest first, each with amount, fee, net, currency and reporting_category in the currency's smallest unit) and has_more (true when there were more than 100).
4. To see the sums per currency for the month, run tool:read-business instead, which calls this tool for you.

worked_examples.title: Five Stripe entries since the 1st of October 2026
worked_examples.ask: List the money that moved on my Stripe account since October 1, 2026, newest first.
worked_examples.given: From the row's request GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/balance_transactions?limit=100&created[gte]=1790812800 (the 1st of October 2026 UTC) with Authorization: Bearer <your key>, and the Stripe answer the test in test/business-screen.test.mjs gives for it (not a live Stripe call).
worked_examples.hands_back: {"object":"list","has_more":false,"data":[{"object":"balance_transaction","amount":10000,"fee":320,"net":9680,"currency":"usd","reporting_category":"charge","type":"charge"},{"object":"balance_transaction","amount":5050,"fee":176,"net":4874,"currency":"usd","reporting_category":"charge","type":"charge"},{"object":"balance_transaction","amount":-2000,"fee":0,"net":-2000,"currency":"usd","reporting_category":"refund","type":"refund"},{"object":"balance_transaction","amount":-8000,"fee":0,"net":-8000,"currency":"usd","reporting_category":"payout","type":"payout"},{"object":"balance_transaction","amount":3000,"fee":120,"net":2880,"currency":"eur","reporting_category":"charge","type":"charge"}]} (amounts in the currency's smallest unit; a 200-299 answer is a success).
